aboutBrand.title: The Maison
aboutBrand.description: Discover the heritage, savoir-faire, and ritual of Maison Rocheval.

hero.title: THE MAISON
hero.imageAlt: Misty lake at the source of Maison Rocheval caviar

story.title: The name came later
story.eyebrow: Before the Maison, there was the source
story.paragraph1: Our foundations formed years earlier, at the water’s edge, alongside producers whose understanding of sturgeon husbandry runs decades deep.
story.paragraph2: That proximity taught us to see caviar as something decided long before the tin: in the water that raises the fish, the feed it is given, the years it is allowed, and the moment it is finally taken. Each decision was refined long before the caviar is eventually served.
story.paragraph3: Maison Rocheval exists to hold that knowledge together. A deep respect for everything that happens before the harvest, and a clear conviction about what earns the right to carry the name.
story.imageAlt: Founder of Maison Rocheval standing in front of a dining table and classical painting

venues.title: At the table
venues.intro: In time, that knowledge found its way to the tables of chefs and private hosts. Each service sharpened the same idea a little further: what the next generation of caviar could be.

willow.name: Willow | Chef Nicolas Tam
willow.description: Chef Nicolas Tam showcases precision, technique, and heritage in his signature dish of Amadai with crispy scales.
willow.imageAlt: White restaurant building surrounded by tropical greenery

alliance.name: Alliance | Chef Toshitaka Omiya
alliance.description: Chef Toshitaka Omiya's cuisine is defined by restraint and an instinct for letting exceptional ingredients speak for themselves.
alliance.imageAlt: Dining room at Alliance restaurant in Paris

sushiSakuta.name: Sushi Sakuta | Chef Yoshio Sakuta
sushiSakuta.description: Chef Yoshio Sakuta’s preparation process is meticulously calculated to ensure that every guest taste the ingredients at their best.

potong.name: POTONG | Chef Pichaya Soontornyanakij
potong.description: At Bangkok’s Restaurant Potong, Chef Pichaya "Pam" Soontornyanakij masterfully weaves luxury caviar into her progressive Thai-Chinese tasting menus.
potong.imageAlt: Dining room at Potong restaurant in Bangkok

selection.title: Time is part of the harvest
selection.description: Selection begins upstream. How the sturgeon was raised, what it was fed, and the moment chosen for harvest.
selection.imageAlt: Producer selecting a sturgeon at harvest
selection.caption: The caviar is read as a whole
selection.detail1: Colour, grain, texture, firmness and moisture are considered alongside salinity, aroma, maturation and the integrity of each pearl.
selection.detail2: On the palate, flavour unfolds in layers. What appears first matters, but so does what remains: depth, length and the character of the finish.

ritual.title: THE RITUAL
ritual.statement: The final expression is in the serving

sourceToRitual.title: From source to ritual
sourceToRitual.intro: Caviar has always carried ceremony: the chilled tin, the turn of the key, mother-of-pearl against the grain, the first spoonful taken before anyone speaks.
sourceToRitual.description: Maison Rocheval preserves that ceremony with restraint. Not as a performance, but because how something is served changes how it is remembered, and the finest tables understand this instinctively, whether found in a celebrated dining room or set for two at home.
sourceToRitual.preparationAlt: Chef preparing a tin of caviar
sourceToRitual.serviceAlt: Caviar served in a glass dish
